blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY — While ASEAN senior leaders met in Metro Manila, Lapu-Lapu City hosted the 80th ASEAN Working Group on Intellectual Property Cooperation (AWGIPC) meeting delegates on Tuesday, November 17. Mayor Cindi King-Chan welcomed delegates to the gathering, saying the event showed the city’s “growing role in fostering international dialogue and cooperation.” The Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines (IPOPHL) hosted the meeting, in partnership with the Lapu-Lapu City Government.
